messages.subject: CmdStan installation instructions
parts:
http://mc-stan.org/cmdstan.html Get Started section says 
"The guide to installing and getting started with CmdStan on all platforms is currently included with the modeling language manual (see below)."
which is not true anymore and it took me sometime to notice that I need to look at "CmdStan Interface User's Guide,  v2.5.0", which is mentioned *above* that Get Started section.
